---
title: "Home runs"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
hr_by_season <- Teams |>
	group_by(yearID) |>
	summarise(
		total_home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
		total_team_games = sum(G, na.rm = TRUE)
	) |>
	mutate(
		home_runs_per_game = total_home_runs / total_team_games,
		season_type = factor(
			if_else(
				yearID %in% c(1918, 1919, 1981, 1994, 1995, 2020),
				"Shortened season",
				"Full season"
			),
			levels = c("Full season", "Shortened season")
		)
	)
```

```{r}
ggplot(hr_by_season, aes(x = yearID, y = home_runs_per_game)) +
	geom_line(aes(color = season_type)) +
	scale_color_manual(
		values = c("Full season" = "#6b7280", "Shortened season" = "#d94841")
	) +
	labs(
		title = "Home Runs per Team-Game Across MLB History",
		x = "Season",
		y = "Home runs per team-game",
		color = "Season type",
		caption = "Source: Lahman database"
	)
```

```{r}
season_comparison <- hr_by_season |>
	filter(yearID %in% c(2019, 1981, 1994, 2020)) |>
	select(yearID, total_home_runs, total_team_games, home_runs_per_game) |>
	arrange(match(yearID, c(2019, 1981, 1994, 2020)))

knitr::kable(season_comparison, digits = 3)
```
